title: Texas Friday nights.
old_caption:
Ever been the one sitting alone in the stands?
Leo shows up, sits close and cheers loud. Be someone's biggest fan.

title: In Houston, your date could be from anywhere.
old_caption:
Ever half-listened on a date?
Sagittarius has one tip: ask where they're from, then listen to the whole story.

title: When the Moon is full…
old_caption:
Does the full moon make everything feel bigger?
If something's bugging you, say it gently. Gentle is brave.

title: Dear Galveston.
old_caption:
Cancer, do you carry home with you wherever you go?
On a Galveston beach, Capricorn brings a towel and Cancer learns to share the shell.

title: Dear Gemini: you kept one chat.
old_caption:
Texting someone every day but never really talking?
Gemini and Sagittarius are at the same table. Time to put the phones down.

title: The ghost's first date.
old_caption:
Not ready to show someone everything yet?
The ghost keeps the sheet on but says how it feels. Honesty first, the rest can wait.

title: The ghost got ghosted.
old_caption:
Ever been stood up after three texts marked delivered?
The ghost finally gets ghosted, and learns why a kind goodbye matters.

title: The ghost made a friend.
old_caption:
Do you vanish the second things feel awkward?
The ghost learns to stay. Awkward beats absent every time.

title: The ghost moved to Houston.
old_caption:
Left someone on read and felt bad about it?
The ghost moves cities and sends a kind goodbye instead. Not a match can still be said gently.

title: Saturn's class graduates.
old_caption:
What did this year teach you about love?
Saturn's class graduates: patterns spotted, wants named, kind goodbyes. Grown-up love is a choice.
